query: Why is ICA removing the departure endorsement?
reference_answer: The removal of the departure endorsement is part of ICA's on-going efforts to streamline procedures at the checkpoints to facilitate faster and more efficient immigration clearance.
context:

ICA no longer issues departure endorsements. You may use proxy documents, such as boarding passes as indicators of your exit record.

[Document 2]
The removal of the departure endorsement is part of ICA's on-going efforts to streamline procedures at the checkpoints to facilitate faster and more efficient immigration clearance.

answer: ICA is removing the departure endorsement to streamline procedures and facilitate faster immigration clearance. This change is part of ongoing efforts by ICA to improve efficiency at checkpoints. It allows for the use of proxy documents like boarding passes to indicate exit records instead of traditional endorsements. [Document 1] & [Document 2]
